WITH vote_ratios AS (
    SELECT p.death_country AS country,
           1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0) AS ratio
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM vote_ratios
    WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       average_ratio,
       average_ratio / AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean
FROM country_averages;
